name: nocturne-gateway
description: Step 4 of 4: Nocturne routing gateway. Requires all other Nocturne templates and files generated by prepare.sh. Point your existing HTTPS reverse proxy at Unraid port 1612 and preserve Host, X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto. No bundled Watchtower or Docker socket access. Community packaging, not an official Nocturne product.

ports.name: HTTP gateway port
ports.description: Forward your HTTPS reverse proxy to this port. Keep API, web and PostgreSQL private.
